syllabus.head: Introduction to Programming
syllabus.text: Components of a computer system, computing environments, computer languages (machine, assembly, high-level), assembler, compiler, interpreter, syntax and logical errors, creating and running programs, algorithms, flowcharts.

syllabus.head: Introduction to C
syllabus.text: History and basic structure of C programs, compilation and execution stages (pre-processing, compiling, assembling, linking, loading).

syllabus.head: C Tokens
syllabus.text: Keywords, identifiers, constants (integer, real, character), strings, special symbols, variables, data types (primary, derived, user-defined; size and range modifiers: short, long, signed, unsigned, volatile).

syllabus.head: I/O Statements
syllabus.text: Formatted and unformatted console input/output statements (printf(), scanf(), getchar(), putchar()).
